title: Republican Palace Museum

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified terrain sampled outside the documented west narthex and terrace.

mapIdentity.scope: The 12-point OpenStreetMap outline fixes the approximately 57 m by 25 m cruciform shell. Schultz’s 1915 plan places the separate campanile to the southwest and shows the covered passage linking it to the church.

note: The 1912 account specifies yellow and pale-red sandstone, green glazed roof tile, deep eaves, two feet from ground to terrace and four feet from terrace to the church floor. The west drawing shows the pointed portal, clustered rose lights, hoods, and the separate clock and belfry stages.
